editorial.blurb: Tsehay serves deeply flavored, traditional Ethiopian cuisine in a warm, beautifully calm space—just come hungry and prepared to linger over every intentional bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the lamb dish if you eat meat, or go for the vegan platter with a group to maximize value and share the full range of their vegetable dishes; the flavors shine when you taste everything together.

topDishes.note: perfect flavors showcasing all vegetarian dishes
